---
title: "Everyday Tomato Sauce"
description: The one that goes on pasta, under eggs and into lasagne.
categories: [component, dinner, pasta, vegan, batch-cook]
makes: tomato sauce
time: 40 min
servings: 4
---

## Ingredients

- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 200 g [soffritto](soffritto.qmd)
- 3 cloves garlic, sliced
- 2 × 400 g tins of plum tomatoes <!-- tomato -->
- 1 tsp salt
- A pinch of sugar
- A handful of basil

## Method

1. Warm the oil in a wide pan and add the soffritto. If it is frozen, let it thaw and drive off its water over medium heat, 5 minutes.
2. Add the garlic and cook for a minute, until fragrant.
3. Tip in the tomatoes, crushing them in your hand as they go. Add the salt and sugar.
4. Simmer uncovered for 25–30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce no longer weeps water when you drag a spoon through it.
5. Tear in the basil off the heat.

Doubles happily. Freezes for three months.
